title: Apartment
subtitle: A bright home above the city

anchorAudit.rationale: Re-authored every anchor and navigation crop from the final bright 1600 by 900 JPEG. The four rooms and central stair core are spatially disjoint; the expanded set keeps room-level nouns at overview and exposes independently pointable furniture, fixtures and visible parts as the camera moves deeper. A second pixel review adds only the clearly separated sofa arm, chair seat, kitchen drawer and bathroom fitting parts while retaining the original exclusions for an obscured sink, hallway and dresser. The professional vocabulary pass adds 30 additional region-grounded nouns across the reviewed facilities, equipment, diagnostic, disease, medicine or building-system crops.
